description:
Intent i013 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=ioctl-sock-usercopy-string) complete. Searched only snapshots/s03 with pattern queries: memdup_user/vmemdup_user followed by string parsers, ioctl handler bodies containing copy_from_user plus string ops, setsockopt files, and direct nla_data->string-helper sites; triaged ~16 candidates.

FIVE REPORTED FINDINGS (artifact: agent-state/findings/i013.json, all quotes literal source substrings):
1. HIGH: drivers/net/ethernet/brocade/bna/bnad_debugfs.c:313-321 — bnad_debugfs_write_regrd (debugfs 'regrd' .write) does kern_buf = memdup_user(buf, nbytes) then sscanf(kern_buf, "%x:%x", &addr, &len) with no NUL terminator, no memdup_user_nul/strndup_user, no +1 slot, no NUL check; sscanf scans past the exactly-nbytes allocation. Exact structural twin of the seed CVE (scsi bfa bfad_debugfs regrd).
2. HIGH: same file lines 373-381 — bnad_debugfs_write_regwr repeats it (memdup_user line 375, sscanf line 379); file has zero memdup_user_nul/strndup_user (grep count 0).
3. HIGH: drivers/s390/cio/cio_inject.c:96-104 — crw_inject_write (debugfs 'crw_inject' .write, crw_fops line 152) does buffer = vmemdup_user(buf, lbuf) then a seven-conversion sscanf(buffer, ...) on the unterminated buffer; kvfree happens only after the OOB parse.
4. MEDIUM: drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_debugfs.c:174-186 — ice_debugfs_module_write does cmd_buf = memdup_user(buf, count) (count<=8 enforced) then sscanf(cmd_buf, "%s", user_val); identical pattern in three sibling handlers (lines 260/264, 335/339, 431/435); OOB read bounded to a few bytes past a small kmalloc object.
5. MEDIUM: drivers/crypto/intel/qat/qat_common/adf_ctl_drv.c:164-172 — QAT char-dev ioctl path (adf_ctl_ioctl -> adf_ctl_ioctl_dev_config -> adf_copy_key_value_data) copy_from_user's adf_user_cfg_key_val/section structs whose char key[64]/val[64]/name[64] (adf_cfg_user.h, ADF_CFG_MAX_STR_LEN 64) carry no termination guarantee, then adf_add_key_value_data passes them to adf_cfg_add_key_value_param's strscpy (adf_cfg.c:268) and strcmp-based lookups (adf_cfg_key_value_find ~:193, adf_cfg_sec_find ~:206), scanning past the 64-byte fields.

SAFE (concrete counterevidence): rvu_debugfs.c uses memdup_user(buffer, count+1) plus explicit cmd_buf[count]='\0'; btrfs ioctl guards every vol_args use with memchr(vol_args->name,0,sizeof)!=NULL (btrfs_check_ioctl_vol_args_path :230); hidp memdup_user feeds a length-bounded binary HID parser; snd_timer strscpy sources are kernel strings; ipvs netlink MCAST_IFN is NLA_NUL_STRING-policy-protected; tipc checks string_is_terminated before strcmp; remoteproc_cdev uses strncmp bounded by len; ntb_tool sets buf[buf_size]='\0' before sscanf; pstore vmemdup buffer is raw bytes, no string parser; hpsa sscanf is on a constant; slcan strlen is on kernel dev->name.

Limitations: ioctl branch audited via pattern scan rather than full per-handler reading, so variants hidden in deeply inlined helpers or vendor libraries called from ioctls could be missed; compat ioctl wrappers and io_uring not exhaustively audited; ice/QAT findings are code-level invariant violations whose dynamic OOB was not reproduced; all debugfs/ioctl-node findings presume access to the respective device/debugfs node.
